data.camera: medium shot, applying glitter eyeshadow before the backstage vanity mirror
data.description: 【星野爱 · 后台化妆间】演出前的后台化妆间里，星野爱对着化妆镜补上最后一笔亮片眼影，镜灯把她的侧脸照得近乎透明——「化妆是舞台魔法的一部分……你看，一点就亮啦。」
data.promptProse: Ai finishes a touch of glitter eyeshadow at the backstage vanity, her pink frilled idol dress and heart brooch reflected beneath her rabbit hair ornament. The medium view holds the makeup tool beside her eye and the mirror surface directly behind, with cosmetics across the near table. Vanity bulbs illuminate her profile and glitter particles, casting small bottle shadows on the counter and soft shade beneath her raised wrist.
data.title: 星野爱 · 后台化妆间
